findings.comment: Comment entries OWB1, OWB3, OWB4, and OWB5 are entirely empty, containing only a status header ("Current Status: Cleared") with no comment text, U0 updates, or U1 responses. These entries provide no information to the applicant about the requirement or how it was addressed. All other comments in the review record follow the standard format of Status header + U0 initial comment + U1 update response; these four entries violate that pattern by containing zero substantive content.
